title: stabilize-graph-replay-with-shape-sentinel-layer-and-replay-throttle
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Mitigates intermittent warmup regressions with graph replay by introducing shape sentinels and a replay throttling controller. Backwards-compatible; runtime will prefer sentinel-aware captures when available.
description:
Summary: This PR addresses intermittent regressions during CUDA graph capture/replay warmup caused by high variance in shape sequences and aggressive immediate-recapture retries. Two primary mitigations are introduced: 1) a lightweight 'shape sentinel' metadata layer that augments shape-compatibility scoring (extends existing shape guards without changing capture semantics), and 2) a replay throttling controller that staggers capture attempts with a progressive backoff and enforces a small probing window to validate kernel mappings before committing a full capture. Also includes a KV-cache alignment fix that prevented some replay candidates from hitting the cache and a scheduler hint to bias kernel selection toward stable, quantized-friendly kernels during the probing phase.

Commits (high-level):
- Add shape sentinel metadata prototype and scoring update (runtime/capture/sentinel.cc, sentinel.h)
- Implement replay throttling controller and config knobs (runtime/replay/throttle_controller.cc)
- KV-cache alignment fix and tests (runtime/kv/kv_alignment.cc, tests/kv_alignment_test.cpp)
- Kernel selector hint changes and microbench harness (runtime/scheduler/kernel_selector.cc, perf/microbench/replay_probe_bench.py)
- Integration tests & docs (tests/perf/replay_warmup_test.py, docs/replay_stability.md)

Files changed (high-level):
- runtime/capture/sentinel.cc/h: add sentinel scoring and serialization
- runtime/replay/throttle_controller.cc: new controller and config options
- runtime/kv/kv_alignment.cc: fix alignment for pending captures
- runtime/scheduler/kernel_selector.cc: add probe-time kernel biasing hint
- tests/perf/replay_warmup_test.py: deterministic repro and regression guard
- docs/replay_stability.md: design rationale and rollout notes

Small illustrative snippet (from sentinel scoring):
  // sentinel: prefer exact dimension prefix matches with minor dtype tolerance
  score = base + (prefix_match ? 0.15f : 0.0f) - dtype_mismatch_penalty;

Motivation & context:
We observed multiple production incidents where cold sequences with variable token lengths caused repeated failed captures and elevated latency for several tenants. The root causes were (a) overly strict shape guards that rejected otherwise-safe replays and (b) an eager recapture loop that triggered repeated expensive warmups under fragmented batching. Previous attempts (shape-guards-only) regressed throughput in corner cases. This PR opts for a conservative, observable-first approach: shape sentinels increase compatibility coverage without expanding capture surface, and the throttling controller makes capture attempts explicit and rate-limited so we can rollback without oscillation.

Testing & benchmarks:
- Unit tests added for sentinel serialization and scoring (runtime/capture/tests).
- Regression harness (tests/perf/replay_warmup_test.py) reproduces the production trace from SUP-834 and shows median warmup latency drop from 420ms -> 120ms under simulated fragmented batching.
- Microbench on p4d: probe-phase kernel selection increases probe success rate from 72% -> 94% (perf/microbench results attached in PR comments).

Review thread (highlights):
- Liam O'Connor: "Nice direction. Concerned about additional metadata bloat for each capture. Can sentinel be a single byte mask rather than a struct?"
  - Author (Maya): "We switch to a compact packed bitmask in the final commit (sentinel.h) — overall +8 bytes per capture on average in our microbench. Added a flag to disable sentinel if teams want pure legacy behavior."
- Priya Nair: "What's the expected behavioral change for Dedicated customers pinned to older model variants? Any risk of silent behavior change?"
  - Maya: "No silent changes: sentinel scoring only relaxes replays that would otherwise be rejected; capture semantics are unchanged. Added a feature flag and rollout notes in docs/replay_stability.md."
- Diego Morales: "We saw a small 5% tail increase in an internal smoke run after the first prototype."
  - Maya: "That was due to an aggressive backoff default. Tuned defaults in throttle_controller.cc and reran benchmarks — tail regressed to neutral (±0.4%). Added observability counters for throttle decisions."

CI history: initial run (2025-11-09) reported lint failure and a flaky perf test. Fixes: linted sentinel headers and tightened test timeouts. Second CI run (2025-11-12) had a transient GPU infra failure on integration; rerun (2025-11-13) passed. Final CI (post-review) green on 2025-11-20.

Manual verification & rollout plan:
- Feature gated behind runtime config: replay.sentinals.enabled = true/false and replay.throttle.mode = {off, probe, conservative}. Default for this rollout: probe.
- Canary: 5% traffic for 48h with flamegraph sampling and KV hit metric monitoring.
- Observability: new metrics replay_throttle.invocations, sentinel.score_histogram, probe.success_rate added to per-route telemetry.

Merge decision: Approved by reviewers after two minor followups. Merged via squash on 2025-11-22 (merge method: squash). Change log and rollout doc updated.

Notes for on-call: If customers see a sudden reduction in replay hits after enabling sentinel, flip replay.sentinals.enabled=false and open ENG-1129 for followup.
